41104-the-amazing-argentine-a-new-land-o.title: A New Land Of Enterprise
41104-the-amazing-argentine-a-new-land-o.creator: John Foster Fraser
41104-the-amazing-argentine-a-new-land-o.description: A book by John Foster Fraser. The steward called me at dawn. He thought I was mad because I stood in pyjamas without apparent heed of the mirky drizzle. Beyond the sad waters there was little to see but a low-lying and dreary island with a melancholy lighthouse. No vegetation brightened the scene. There was no gorgeous sunrise. There was nothing but a lump of barrenness heaving out of the sea.

arxiv-2108-13703.title: Evaluating the Robustness of Off-Policy Evaluation Conference: Fifteenth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems; September 27-October 1, 2021; Amsterdam, Netherlands Fifteenth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys ’21), September 27-October 1, 2021, Amsterdam, Netherlands Price: 15.00 DOI: 10
arxiv-2108-13703.creator: Yuta Saito, Takuma Udagawa, Haruka Kiyohara, Kazuki Mogi, Yusuke Narita, Kei Tateno
arxiv-2108-13703.description: Abstract . Off-policy Evaluation (OPE), or offline evaluation in general, evaluates the performance of hypothetical policies leveraging only offline log data. It is particularly useful in applications where the online interaction involves high stakes and expensive setting such as precision medicine and recommender systems.

arxiv-2112-13290.title: An equational approach to enriched distributivity
arxiv-2112-13290.creator: Adriana Balan, Alexander Kurz
arxiv-2112-13290.description: Abstract . The familiar adjunction between ordered sets and completely distributive lattices can be extended to generalised metric spaces, that is, categories enriched over a quantale (a lattice of “truth values”), via an appropriate distributive law between the “down-set” monad and the “up-set” monad on the category of quantale-enriched categories.

arxiv-2212-02141.title: A Cosmological Fireball with Sixteen-Percent Gamma-Ray Radiative Efficiency
arxiv-2212-02141.creator: Liang Li, Yu Wang, Felix Ryde, Asaf Pe’er, Bing Zhang, Sylvain Guiriec, Alberto J. Castro-Tirado, D. Alexander Kann, Magnus Axelsson, Kim Page, Péter Veres, P. N. Bhat
arxiv-2212-02141.description: Abstract Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) are the most powerful explosions in the universe. How efficiently the jet converts its energy to radiation is a long-standing problem and it is poorly constrained. The standard model invokes a relativistic fireball with a bright photosphere emission component.

arxiv-2403-13323.title: Spontaneous formation of Frenkel defects in high-entropy-alloys-type compound
arxiv-2403-13323.creator: Rikuya Ishikawa, Kyohei Takae, Yoshikazu Mizuguchi, Rei Kurita
arxiv-2403-13323.description: Abstract High-entropy alloys (HEAs) are attracting attention due to their exceptional properties, such as enhanced mechanical toughness, superconducting robustness, and thermoelectric performance. Numerous HEAs have been developed for diverse applications, ranging from self-healing in fusion reactors to addressing environmental concerns with thermoelectric materials. Understanding atomic diffusion within HEA crystals is crucial for these applications.

arxiv-2406-01277.title: ColdSIM predictions of [C ii ] emission in primordial galaxies
arxiv-2406-01277.creator: Benedetta Casavecchia, Umberto Maio, Céline Péroux, Benedetta Ciardi
arxiv-2406-01277.description: Abstract Context. A powerful tool with which to probe the gas content at high redshift is the [C ii ] 158 μ \mu m submillimetre emission line, which, due to its low excitation potential and luminous emission, is considered a possible direct tracer of star forming gas. Aims.

arxiv-2411-02610.title: Investigating Idiomaticity in Word Representations
arxiv-2411-02610.creator: Wei He, Tiago Kramer Vieira, Marcos Garcia, Carolina Scarton ∗, Marco Idiart ∗∗, Aline Villavicencio ∗
arxiv-2411-02610.description: Abstract Idiomatic expressions are an integral part of human languages, often used to express complex ideas in compressed or conventional ways (e.g. eager beaver as a keen and enthusiastic person). However, their interpretations may not be straightforwardly linked to the meanings of their individual components in isolation and this may have an impact for compositional approaches.

arxiv-2506-17082.title: Matroids, intersecting bases, and Borsuk property Thanks: † \dagger Supported by INSMI-CNRS
arxiv-2506-17082.creator: Gyivan López-Campos, Frédéric Meunier, Jorge L. Ramírez Alfonsín †
arxiv-2506-17082.description: Abstract . A subset S S of ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} has the Borsuk property if it can be decomposed into at most d + 1 d+1 parts of diameter smaller than S S . This is an important geometric property, inspired by a conjecture of Borsuk from the 1930s, which has attracted considerable attention over the years.

arxiv-2511-23320.title: Too Big to Monitor? Network Scale and the Breakdown of Decentralized Monitoring
arxiv-2511-23320.creator: Guy Tchuente
arxiv-2511-23320.description: Abstract Many public services are produced in networked systems where quality depends on local effort and on how higher-level authorities monitor providers. We develop a simple model in which monitoring is a public good on a network with strategic complementarities. A regulator chooses between decentralized monitoring (cheaper, local oversight) and centralized monitoring (more costly, but internalizing spillovers).

europmc-pmc2001387.title: Second primary neoplasms in patients with retinoblastoma.
europmc-pmc2001387.creator: Draper GJ, Sanders BM, Kingston JE.
europmc-pmc2001387.description: In a series of 882 retinoblastoma patients, 384 known to have the genetic form of the disease and 498 others, 30 patients developed second primary neoplasms. The spectrum of these second neoplasms is discussed in relation to the forms of treatment used for the retinoblastoma....

pmc-13172093.title: The inhibitory effects of Melicope pahangenesis T. G. Hartley extract on LPS-induced acute lung injury
pmc-13172093.creator: Hee Jung Choi, Min Jeong Kim, Jin Hyub Paik, Dong Joon Kim, Sung Keun Jung
pmc-13172093.description: Since COVID-19 pandemic, the protection of lung health against infection with various pathogens has been emphasized. Acute lung injury (ALI) is a severe respiratory disease that causes sudden loss of lung function via pathogenic invasion. Although diverse anti-inflammatory materials have been investigated, the preventive efficacy remains limited.

pmc-13279475.creator: Oliver M Schleicher, Alaa Hamzeh, Julia Gocke, Patrik Poeschke, Frederik A Stuebs, Stefanie Burghaus, Felix Heindl, Arndt Hartmann, Matthias W Beckmann, Christian Matek, Julius Emons

pmc-13381857.title: A rapid image acquisition method for external defect inspection of battery can
pmc-13381857.creator: Wei Yang, Chunfeng Huang, Pengfei Ji
pmc-13381857.description: During the manufacturing process, battery cans may have appearance defects such as scratches, dents, and stains. The reliability of the battery will be reduced if these defects are not detected. Machine vision based inspection methods have high inspection accuracy and stability, gradually replacing manual inspection. The efficiency of machine vision inspection method is constrained by the efficiency of image acquisition.
